color.meaning: Noisy RT radiance at R; standard RGB format. Physical format alone does not establish scene linear/HDR domain or exposure.

output.meaning: Output at O in standard RGB/RGBA format.

diffuse.meaning: Linear diffuse reflectance at R; no sRGB texture.

specular.meaning: Linear specular reflectance at R; no sRGB texture; engine BRDF-dependent generation.

normals.meaning: Normalized shading normals in known view/world space at R, FP16/32 RGB; packed roughness requires matching mode.

roughness.meaning: Linear surface roughness at R; standalone R channel or normals alpha with matching create-time mode.

motion.meaning: Dense primary scene/camera/dynamic motion at R in RG16/32_FLOAT. NGX MV.Scale converts stored values to pixel space; SL normalization is a different interface.

depth.meaning: Primary depth matching primary motion; view-space Z or HW depth with known create-time representation.

reflection.meaning: Specular motion vectors at R OR specular hit distance plus WorldToView and ViewToClip. Distance is world-space from primary surface; no claim that all native runtimes hard-reject absent pointers.

transparency.meaning: RGBA premultiplied RGB with alpha blend factor, or RGB color plus RGB opacity. Preserve chosen representation.

before-transparency.meaning: Noisy color before transparency; same image format as Color. Precision differences can change inferred transparency.

header-extra.meaning: Declared by NGX helper; this audit found no cited semantic requirement in the RR guide. Do not relabel required/optional from pointer presence.

optional-helper.meaning: Listed after helper OPTIONAL marker; semantic conditions and raw original values still matter.

eval.meaning: Declared before optional marker in NGX D3D12 Eval Params; preserve raw values and getter result.

create.meaning: Set by official RR Create helper, not reliably reconstructible from Evaluate-only probing.
